title: Day must be a whole number from 1 to 31
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Start on the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group), Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Click "New Credit Term".
  2. Type "Day X" in Name.
  3. Click the Day box.
  4. Type 0 in the Day box.
  5. Replace it with 32.
  6. Replace it with 2.5.
  7. Replace it with 31.
  8. Replace it with 1.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The "New Credit Term" window opens.

Step 2:

  • The Name reads Day X.

Step 3:

  • "Due day of the following month" is chosen.

Step 4:

  • The message "Enter a day from 1 to 31." shows under the Day box.

Step 5:

  • The message "Enter a day from 1 to 31." shows.

Step 6:

  • The message "Enter a day from 1 to 31." shows.

Step 7:

  • The message disappears and the blue line shows.

Step 8:

  • No message, and the blue line shows.
